mcat_description.short: Container Fabrication Services covers the custom design, fabrication, and modification of steel containers into functional structures — primarily portable site office cabins, storage containers, and specialised units — built to buyer-specified dimensions and fittings.
mcat_description.long: Container Fabrication Services in India encompasses the end-to-end custom fabrication of mild steel (MS) or galvanised iron (GI) container structures, including new-build portable office cabins, site office containers, storage containers, refrigerated containers, and modified shipping containers. Fabricators work to buyer-specified dimensions (typically 10×8 ft to 40×10 ft), material grades (IS-grade MS, GI, FRP), insulation types (PUF, glasswool, EPS), and interior fitouts (electrical, plumbing, partitions, furniture). The dominant application in India is construction-site and industrial-site portable office infrastructure, driven by large-scale infrastructure projects, mining, and manufacturing expansion. The Indian modular container market is growing at a CAGR of approximately 13.5% (2024–2030), with mobile modular containers as the largest and fastest-growing segment.

market_context: Container Fabrication Services in India spans custom fabrication of portable steel site office containers, prefabricated cabins, refrigerated containers, and truck body containers — with the construction and industrial site office segment dominating demand. Indian fabricators use IS-grade mild steel (MS) and galvanised iron (GI) as primary structural materials, with insulation options including PUF (50mm), glasswool (25–50mm), and EPS thermocol (40mm). Standard cabin dimensions range from 10×8 ft to 40×10 ft; custom dimensions are common. The India modular container market is projected to grow at a CAGR of 13.5% (2024–2030), with mobile modular containers as the largest revenue segment. The construction application segment leads globally in shipping container modification demand (Allied Market Research, Straits Research — two independent sources). Key Indian fabrication hubs include Chennai, Ahmedabad, Pune, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, and the NCR region. Tata Steel's Nest-In (MobiNest) is a notable branded player; most of the market is served by unbranded regional fabricators. Refrigerated container fabrication is a distinct sub-segment serving cold chain logistics, with Chennai as a noted hub (per internal keyword signals). Truck body container fabrication (dry van, insulated) serves fleet owners and e-commerce logistics under CMVR/AIS vehicle body standards — a separate buyer and regulatory context from site office containers.
